item.text: {"category_edits":[{"category":"feature_construction","rationale":"Across all four datasets, use the fourth root of normalized training-only log counts to increase attenuation of moderately frequent historical items. Unseen items retain zero features. The existing checkpoint buffer and predictor preserve inference consistency without changing embeddings, topology, readout, loss or optimizer.","edits":[{"find":"    frequency_feature = np.sqrt(frequency_feature)","replace":"    frequency_feature = np.power(frequency_feature, 0.25)"}]}],"change_summary":"Change the training-frequency feature from sqrt(z) to z**0.25 for all four category models, retaining attenuation 1-0.3*feature and existing checkpoint-backed inference."}
